description: Keyless DELAYED market data (Yahoo/Stooq, ~15m or EOD) for indices, index futures (incl. night session), FX, rates, vol, commodities, and stocks. Accepts plain names ('KOSPI','纳指期货','VIX','美元指数','10年美债','黄金') or raw tickers (^KS11, ES=F, 7203.T). Use for real index/futures/macro numbers; on error treat as a data gap (open_questions). Not real-time, not investment advice.
